summary: Mobile end-to-end testing reached registration, login/dashboard, and item creation. TopPass5 title and Google link passed. Reveal/copy/delete could not complete because reveal remained masked; mobile logout is not visible. Recovery endpoint responded successfully.

minor.issue: Regression suite cannot collect unless REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported; collection raises AttributeError on None.rstrip().

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button exists but is display:none at mobile width, preventing a normal UI logout/login journey.
After creating an item and clicking reveal on mobile, the value remained masked and assertion did not observe plaintext; copy/delete were consequently not verified.

action_items: Investigate mobile reveal request/state update and ensure plaintext is shown after clicking reveal.
Expose a mobile logout control or equivalent session control.
Run backend regression with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL loaded from frontend/.env or pytest configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: Vault load function is recreated on every render and triggers an exhaustive-deps warning; stabilize it with useCallback or explicitly document the effect dependency.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_ accounts and TEST Mobile Secret items during browser testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Title/branding, registration, login/dashboard, item creation, Google link, and unknown-email recovery passed. Re-test mobile reveal/copy/delete and logout; do not assert CSS pseudo-element text.
rca of the issue: The mobile CSS hides .sidebar, which contains the only logout button. Reveal failure was reproduced after item creation and clicking the reveal test id; the item stayed masked, suggesting the async reveal response/state update is not completing or the clicked control is not wired correctly on mobile.
